title: WhimTex live API field definitions
description: Reusable field shapes for live API patches and brush authoring. Not a document or clipboard envelope; use document.schema.json for stored layers.

casing.description: Display-only casing. SmallCaps draws lowercase as smaller capitals; stored text is unchanged.

edgeMode.description: Glyph rasterization: HintedAA (default) uses grid-fitted antialiasing; Antialiased uses antialiasing without hinting; Pixel uses binary glyph coverage, snapped glyph placement and nearest sampling by default. Explicit filtering and FX can soften Pixel output; this is not final-alpha quantization. Omitted fields in partial updates retain their values.

fontSize.description: Fixed size, or minimum size with Frame Auto Size enabled.

maxFontSize.description: Maximum size with Frame Auto Size enabled. Range must contain a whole-pixel size.

characterHorizontalScale.description: Glyph-width and advance multiplier. Height and additive em spacing are unchanged. Used by wrapping, Auto Size and Ellipsis.

spacing.description: Extra spacing in em of the effective font size. All default to zero. Paragraph applies only after explicit breaks. Partial patches preserve omitted values.

layoutOffset.description: Layout translation in local document pixels before rasterization, separate from the layer transform. Used by Point/Frame layout handles and preserved across Point/Frame switches. Frame resize changes this offset and frameSize, never the layer transform.

overflow.description: Frame overflow: None keeps text outside the frame, Clip cuts it, Ellipsis shortens visible text with an ellipsis. Ignored for Point text.

autoSize.description: Fit text into Frame between fontSize and maxFontSize. Ignored for Point text.

gradientStops.description: Stops must have strictly increasing times.

scale.description: Scalar sets XY, or XYZ in active ThreeD. [x,y] preserves Z; [x,y,z] sets all axes literally. Inspect returns XYZ, including inactive Z. XY units span the shorter canvas side; Z multiplies Offset Z to select a ThreeD slice and defaults to 1 in older files. Ignored by White/Blue. Seamless fits complete lattice cells per octave/warp, so small Scale changes can quantize.

field.description: Value: scalar/grain; Curl: swirling flow; GradientVector: derivative; CellDirection: nearest cellular center. Unsupported stored Noise Type temporarily uses OpenSimplex2 (CellDirection uses Cellular). Hidden settings are retained.

vectorOutput.description: Linear RGB = XYZ * 0.5 + 0.5 or signed XYZ. No gamma or implicit clipping. Alpha 1. Color Range and combining layers/groups require HDR for signed or out-of-range values.

normalize.description: Vector fields only. Normalize nonzero vectors before Strength; zero remains zero.

strength.description: Vector magnitude multiplier after optional normalization.

linkScale.description: Scale chain in the UI. Explicit API scale values are applied literally, even when linked.

periodic.description: UI Seamless: X joins left/right, Y joins top/bottom, XY joins both. Ignored in OneD and White/Blue Noise; retained when inactive. Z never repeats.

periodic1D.description: UI Seamless in OneD: repeat along the projected noise axis, including Fractal and Warp. Independent of periodic; ignored outside OneD and for White/Blue. Angled stripes need not tile at canvas edges.

offset.description: [x,y] preserves Z in updates; [x,y,z] sets all axes. Z selects a ThreeD slice. XY uses noise-space units, or canvas pixels for White/Blue.

warpSeed.description: Independent seed for Domain Warp. Ignored when Warp is disabled or its Strength is zero.

warpScale.description: XYZ multipliers of Noise Scale. Number sets active axes; [x,y] preserves Z; [x,y,z] sets all axes. Inspect returns XYZ. Seamless fits resulting warp periods; Z never repeats.

linkWarpScale.description: Warp Scale chain: UI and Random All preserve proportions; explicit API axes apply literally.

encoding.description: UI Output for Field Value only. Gradient maps monochrome noise through its RGBA/HDR palette. Color White/Blue temporarily renders stored Gradient as ColorValues. Vector fields use vectorOutput instead.

inverted.description: Scalar: 1-value before palette. Vector: reverse direction before packing. Applies to every output.

gradient.description: Default opaque black at 0, white at 1, Perceptual interpolation. Replaces the complete palette; does not change encoding. Retained in other output modes.

dimensions.description: OneD stripes, TwoD field or ThreeD slice at Offset Z. White/Blue temporarily renders stored ThreeD as TwoD; vector fields render stored OneD as TwoD. Inactive values are retained.

arcThickness.description: Arc body thickness in canvas pixels, independent of strokeWidth. Transform controls the centerline ellipse.

poissonEdges.description: Paired edges: TopAndBottom for vertical tiling, LeftAndRight for horizontal tiling. None bypasses only this pass, independently of other passes.

mirrorPoissonEdges.description: Paired edges: TopAndBottom for vertical tiling, LeftAndRight for horizontal tiling. None bypasses only this pass, independently of other passes.

offsetPoissonEdges.description: Paired edges: TopAndBottom for vertical tiling, LeftAndRight for horizontal tiling. None bypasses only this pass, independently of other passes.

mode.description: Method. Inactive method settings are retained, not transferred or reset.

processRed.description: Channels: false restores this input channel after seam processing, before normal layer FX/compositing. All false bypasses seam processing.

processGreen.description: Channels: false restores this input channel after seam processing, before normal layer FX/compositing. All false bypasses seam processing.

processBlue.description: Channels: false restores this input channel after seam processing, before normal layer FX/compositing. All false bypasses seam processing.

processAlpha.description: Channels: false restores this input channel after seam processing, before normal layer FX/compositing. All false bypasses seam processing.

blendWidth.description: Mirror Blend Width: fraction of each corresponding canvas dimension.

mirrorTransitionStart.description: Mirror Transition Start: fraction of Blend Width, not the canvas. Negative values may reopen the seam; changing this does not toggle Poisson correction.

mirrorAutoRadius.description: Automatic Radius uses max(0.005, blendWidth/4); the manual radius remains stored.

mirrorCorrectionRadius.description: Poisson Radius: fraction of the smaller canvas dimension. Global correction, not a hard band. Manual correction radii are unused while their Automatic Radius is enabled.

screeningRadius.description: Poisson Radius: fraction of the smaller canvas dimension. Global correction, not a hard band. Manual correction radii are unused while their Automatic Radius is enabled.

edgeWidth.description: Offset Blend Width: fraction of each corresponding canvas dimension, at least two pixels.

offsetTransitionStart.description: Offset Transition Start: fraction of Blend Width, not the canvas. Negative values may reopen the seam; changing this does not toggle Poisson correction.

quiltingEdges.description: Paired edges: TopAndBottom for vertical tiling, LeftAndRight for horizontal tiling. None bypasses only this pass, independently of other passes.

quiltingWidth.description: Patch Width: fraction of each corresponding canvas dimension.

quiltingAlongSearch.description: Along-Seam Search: fraction of usable strip length. Donor displacement tapers to zero at the ends, without wrapping.

quiltingFeather.description: Feather is 0..100 percent, not a 0..1 fraction or pixels. Share of each cut's available safe transition width; not a texture blur.

quiltingChannels.description: Channel Matching: Linked uses one donor/cut for checked premultiplied channels; Independent searches each checked straight channel separately for packed maps.

quiltingPoissonEdges.description: Paired edges: TopAndBottom for vertical tiling, LeftAndRight for horizontal tiling. None bypasses only this pass, independently of other passes.

quiltingCorrectionRadius.description: Poisson Radius: fraction of the smaller canvas dimension. Global correction, not a hard band. Manual correction radii are unused while their Automatic Radius is enabled.

offsetAutoRadius.description: Automatic Radius uses max(0.005, edgeWidth/4); the manual radius remains stored.

offsetCorrectionRadius.description: Poisson Radius: fraction of the smaller canvas dimension. Global correction, not a hard band. Manual correction radii are unused while their Automatic Radius is enabled.

makeSeamless.description: Targeted seam-processing layer. Defaults apply to new layers; omitted fields in updates retain their values. Main-pass edges and Poisson correction edges are independent. Percentage UI values use fractions except quiltingFeather.

position.description: Parent-local offset in canvas-pixel units; default [0,0], X right, Y up.

scale.description: Each absolute component must be at least 0.00001.

metric.description: All eleven modes are antialiased. EuclideanAntialiased is UI Round AA (ID 4), preserving the original crossing-seed EDT rather than distance to continuous contour segments. Sharp (5) and Bevel (6) are contour-offset fields, not Euclidean SDFs. Diamond (7) is axis-dependent L1; Square (8) is axis-dependent L-infinity. Sharp/Bevel/Diamond/Square/MTSDF use fixed 0.25-pixel contour simplification. Sharp/Bevel/Diamond/Square/MTSDF fit straight flanks to multiple raw isocontour samples by orthogonal least squares before simplification; sampled flank deviation <= 0.6 px and supported acute caps have an engineering allowance <= sqrt(0.5) px and tip displacement within the measured 8-pixel base support, only when independently straight 16-pixel flanks agree with the base fits and sqrt(0.5) px / cosHalfTurn fits in that support; otherwise tip distance <= min(2 px, 0.6 px / cosHalfTurn). Uncertain flanks are preserved. Closed filled contours undergo NonZero union at 1e-6-pixel precision; holes and genuinely separate islands remain, while regions overlapping after reconstruction share one boundary. Paths with perimeter below 4 px bypass simplification; open and zero-area contours bypass region union. Post-union cleanup uses a 0.05-pixel budget and rejects chords crossing nonincident original or replacement boundaries or changing containment/contact states. MTSDF resolves each contour median before combining contours; alpha remains the nearest true distance. Away from the contour, a common-channel bound certifies safe RGB interpolation; suspect cells receive nine finite-contour distance checks. Geometric sign/amplification errors fall back to true distance, color-only incompatibility preserves the scalar median, and alpha is unchanged. Scalar MTSDF uses the corrected RGB median; near-boundary texels are unchanged. Reconstruction can change subpixel detail and is not an exact original matte. MTSDF (9) has corner-preserving RGB perpendicular/pseudo distances and true signed Euclidean contour distance in alpha. Old IDs 0..3 are removed. Supported concave fits may minimally shift one wall outward within the existing 0.6-pixel envelope to preserve a nearby hole, then recheck finite-tip/topology bounds. After a component merge, one bounded convex-cap enclosure pass checks arc samples and exact unsampled union vertices, without another 0.25-pixel reduction. Closed components with perimeter below 4 pixels keep finite geometry but do not generate distant Sharp/Bevel miter or MTSDF pseudo extensions. Sharp/MTSDF endpoint extensions require at least 2 pixels of straight support on both flanks after union (successive direction dot >= 0.995), with angular amplification capped at 4. Unsupported or above-cap endpoints use finite segment distance, even inside a large merged contour. Sharp resolves finite ownership within each contour before combining contour fields. Very acute or uncertain corners can round; requested Miter Limit above 4 cannot override raster safety. This is a bounded raster reconstruction, not an exact inverse. AAEDT (ID 10, UI AAEDT + 8SED) is an experimental anti-aliased Euclidean sweep-and-update transform with 8-neighbor vector propagation, adapted from Stefan Gustavson edtaa3 in a portable Burst job. It estimates the raster boundary; wide external contours remain round. It bypasses segment reconstruction and sharp/miter extensions; miterLimit and SDF contourMergeDistance are retained and validated but ignored. Source alpha (or the selected source channel) is assumed to be area coverage of a crisp edge, sampled with a box filter; blur, feather and arbitrary opacity do not give exact geometry. For coverage a in 0..1 and normalized byte threshold t=threshold/255, 0<t<1 uses c=0.5*a/t when a<=t, else c=0.5+0.5*(a-t)/(1-t). This monotonic piecewise remap sends t to 0.5 and preserves 0/1 endpoints. Thresholds 0 and 255 use binary coverage: 1 only when the selected byte-range source value exceeds threshold, otherwise 0. Outline uses fixed threshold 128. SDF supports Gradient/LinearData; MultiChannelData remains MTSDF-only. The default Round AA is unchanged. No accuracy or performance superiority is claimed. Contour (ID 11, UI Contour AA) is an experimental Euclidean distance field to finite straight segments extracted by raw marching squares from alpha or the selected source channel. Threshold crossings are linearly interpolated to subpixel endpoints. It applies no contour fitting, smoothing, simplification, corner recovery, merge/union, miter extension or MSDF channel construction. Expanded corners round. It measures the current raster threshold boundary and does not restore lost detail. It is a separate algorithm, not an AAEDT modification or a sharp-miter mode. It uses the existing source-channel, threshold, SourceEdges, offset and rendering wrapper; SDF exposes threshold and Outline uses fixed byte threshold 128. miterLimit and SDF contourMergeDistance are retained and validated but ignored. SDF supports Gradient/LinearData; MultiChannelData remains MTSDF-only. Quality comparison is experimental, with no guaranteed improvement across all inputs. Round AA remains the default at ID 4; AAEDT remains ID 10 and all existing modes are unchanged. CornerFit (ID 12, UI Corner Fit AA) and Spring (ID 13, UI Spring Simulation) are separate experimental raster-only scalar modes for SDF and Outline. CornerFit starts with raw Contour geometry, fits sides over multiple pixels and verifies candidate corners by local AA re-rasterization. Spring first applies automatic spring relaxation to the raw contour, inspired by Matusovic, Parakkat and Eisemann, Interactive Depixelization of Pixel Art through Spring Simulation (2023), DOI 10.1111/cgf.14743, then uses the same AA-tested corner proposals. The paper concerns interactive depixelization, not SDF generation; Spring is not the full interactive tool or a C++ replica. Both reject intersecting or unconfirmed extensions and retain the raw contour for ambiguous cases. Only AA-verified corners receive bounded sharp joins with continuous, local endpoint domains. miterLimit (finite 1..64, default 4) bevels excessive validated joins; it does not validate uncertain corners. Threshold is supported through coverage remapping of the selected source channel; soft/noncoverage masks give an approximate fit. SDF uses its threshold; Outline uses fixed byte threshold 128. Both use the existing scalar downstream controls and support Gradient/LinearData, never MultiChannelData. SDF contourMergeDistance is validated and retained but ignored. CornerFit is an experimental hybrid, not a known guaranteed reconstruction algorithm; neither mode promises universal sharp recovery. Round AA remains the default at ID 4 and the previous eight modes are unchanged. Rbf (ID 14, UI RBF Your SDF) is an experimental 2D adaptation of Cheng and Gingold, arXiv:2609.06209v3 with a WhimTex sharp-offset stage. It seeds cubic RBF interpolation with raster-derived Contour distances, refines implied tangent-circle points in fixed overlapping patches, extracts a half-pixel zero contour, fits supported flanks and normalizes closed regions, then applies experimental unrestricted sharp joins. Fractional contour points are passed directly, without re-rasterizing a mask. This is not the authors full implementation or a Euclidean distance field. RBF omits angle and flank-support caps, nearest-boundary ownership and miter beveling; extra rays and overlaps may appear. Numerical degeneracy and contour-validity checks remain. Rounded input or recovered contour segments are not guaranteed to become sharp. Contour Merge and Miter Limit are ignored. Max Distance remaps the retained scalar field; Changing the retained Miter Limit value does not rebuild RBF geometry or distance. Source or threshold changes reconstruct it. No universal corner-recovery or quality advantage is claimed. Refinement is limited to 16,777,216 samples; one-dimensional input uses Round AA. Gradient/LinearData are supported; MultiChannelData remains MTSDF-only. Current prototype override: sharpMode selects extension policy; its contract supersedes the earlier fixed-cap/correction description.

sharpMode.description: Corner Mode for Sharp, MTSDF, CornerFit, Spring and Rbf. Unrestricted preserves the unguarded prototype. GuardedSharp restores endpoint support, verified-corner eligibility, Sharp finite ownership, MTSDF per-contour channels and sign/seam correction, but removes fixed angular/amplification rounding caps. Invalid or unsupported corners can still use finite distance. Both retain the same contour preparation. Miter Limit bevels excessive scalar joins only in GuardedSharp; MTSDF ignores it. Other algorithms retain but ignore sharpMode.

miterLimit.description: Finite 1..64, default 4. In GuardedSharp, bevels joins above this ratio for Sharp, CornerFit, Spring and Rbf. Ignored in Unrestricted and MTSDF. No separate fixed angular rounding cap.

sharpMode.description: Corner Mode for Sharp, MTSDF, CornerFit, Spring and Rbf. Unrestricted preserves the unguarded prototype. GuardedSharp restores endpoint support, verified-corner eligibility, Sharp finite ownership, MTSDF per-contour channels and sign/seam correction, but removes fixed angular/amplification rounding caps. miterLimit.description: Finite 1..64, default 4. In GuardedSharp, bevels joins above this ratio for Sharp, CornerFit, Spring and Rbf. Ignored in Unrestricted and MTSDF. No separate fixed angular rounding cap.

contourMergeDistance.description: Experimental SDF-only contour merge in current raster/render pixels, independent of distance remap width. Finite 0..2 inclusive; default 0 disables it. Applies only to Sharp and MTSDF; other modes retain but ignore it, with the same validation. One pass merges disjoint consecutive-vertex pairs within one contour, shortest eligible pairs first, to their midpoints. Each pair is within the requested distance; each original vertex is used at most once. Never merges different loops or builds multi-vertex clusters. A topology conflict rolls back the whole batch. Existing safety protections remain. May shift short details and does not guarantee restored sharpness.

threshold.description: Byte threshold 0..255. In AAEDT, normalize to t=threshold/255 and remap coverage monotonically so t maps to 0.5 while 0/1 remain unchanged. Extreme thresholds use binary coverage: 1 only when the selected byte-range source value exceeds threshold, otherwise 0. CornerFit and Spring also support the threshold through coverage remapping; fitting is approximate for soft masks or values that do not represent area coverage. Remaining modes keep their existing threshold behavior.

encoding.description: Gradient/LinearData use the RGB median for MTSDF, then Position, normalization, Inverted and Profile; Gradient samples the palette, LinearData has alpha 1. MultiChannelData requires resulting metric MTSDF and writes raw linear RGBA as saturate(0.5 + 0.5*d/maxDistance) (0 selects auto), bypassing Position, Contour Offset, inside/outside ranges, Inverted, Profile and palette. RGB is perpendicular/pseudo distance; alpha is true signed Euclidean distance to the reconstructed subpixel contour, not coverage, binary-bitmap distance or an exact original matte. MTSDF uses constrained multi-sample corner fitting followed by fixed 0.25-pixel simplification. Sampled flank deviation <= 0.6 px; supported acute caps have an engineering allowance <= sqrt(0.5) px and tip displacement within the measured 8-pixel base support, only when independently straight 16-pixel flanks agree with the base fits and sqrt(0.5) px / cosHalfTurn fits in that support; otherwise tip distance <= min(2 px, 0.6 px / cosHalfTurn). Closed filled contours undergo NonZero union before generating edge colors. Holes and genuinely separate islands remain; overlapping reconstructed regions share one boundary. Tiny paths bypass simplification; open and zero-area contours bypass union. MTSDF resolves each contour median before combining contours; alpha remains the nearest true distance. Away from the contour, a common-channel bound certifies safe RGB interpolation; suspect cells receive nine finite-contour distance checks. Geometric sign/amplification errors fall back to true distance, color-only incompatibility preserves the scalar median, and alpha is unchanged. Scalar MTSDF uses the corrected RGB median; near-boundary texels are unchanged. Use blend Overwrite for raw RGBA composition/export because Normal treats alpha as coverage and can alter data. Standalone ordinary FX/effect-layer inputs receive rendered RGBA. Supported concave fits may minimally shift one wall outward within the existing 0.6-pixel envelope to preserve a nearby hole, then recheck finite-tip/topology bounds. After a component merge, one bounded convex-cap enclosure pass checks arc samples and exact unsampled union vertices, without another 0.25-pixel reduction. Closed components with perimeter below 4 pixels keep finite geometry but do not generate distant Sharp/Bevel miter or MTSDF pseudo extensions. Sharp/MTSDF endpoint extensions require at least 2 pixels of straight support on both flanks after union (successive direction dot >= 0.995), with angular amplification capped at 4. Unsupported or above-cap endpoints use finite segment distance, even inside a large merged contour. Sharp resolves finite ownership within each contour before combining contour fields. Very acute or uncertain corners can round; requested Miter Limit above 4 cannot override raster safety. This is a bounded raster reconstruction, not an exact inverse.

sdf.description: Partial live settings patch. Omitted fields retain their values; the resulting layer must use MTSDF for MultiChannelData. This schema can check the pair only when both fields are supplied.

curve.description: Pressure response on 0..1. linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeInOut, one, or keys((time,value,inTangent,outTangent,inWeight,outWeight,weightedMode),...). At least two keys; times and values within 0..1. Evaluated output is clamped.

strokePressures.description: Optional one normalized pressure per stroke point; length must match points. Omitted: full pressure. Interpolated at stamp positions; no interactive global curve or smoothing. Not supported by Pencil.

points.description: Canvas pixels, top-left origin. One point does not paint.

mixing.description: 0: coordinate deformation without cumulative RGB feedback; 1: carried-color mixing. Partial values couple both on every dab.

writeChannels.description: Write mask: R=1, G=2, B=4, A=8. Disabled channels retain their previous straight values. Disabling A also preserves fully transparent pixels.
